description: Version-local labels and explanatory prompts for authoring tools. No new grammar, result semantics, datatype inference, or allowed-value definitions. Always validate against the pinned native schemas and capability mappings.

authoring.target_platform.label: Target platform
authoring.target_platform.prompt: Which operating system will this Assessment check?
authoring.target_platform.description: Authoring context for choosing available capabilities. This editor-facing selection does not change native Assessment evaluation semantics or assert a CPE/applicability test.

assessment.assessment_title.label: Security requirement
assessment.assessment_title.prompt: What security requirement should be checked?
assessment.assessment_title.description: Human-authored summary, not an executable condition.

assessment.evaluate.label: How the checks combine
assessment.evaluate.description: Combines independent named Test outcomes; not a collection or State-field condition.

assessment.evaluate.all.label: All checks must pass
assessment.evaluate.all.description: Logical AND over Test/Assessment expressions. Do not infer behavior of absent evidence from this operator alone.

assessment.evaluate.any.label: At least one check must pass
assessment.evaluate.any.description: Logical OR over Test/Assessment expressions. This does not imply any particular Item-existence requirement.

test.capability.label: How to inspect
test.capability.prompt: Which capability will collect the evidence?

test.object.label: Data source
test.object.description: Identifies where and how to collect evidence. Collection and comparison are different operations.

object.select.label: Where to look
object.select.description: Capability-specific selectors; do not confuse an Object selector with a State expectation.

test.states.label: What must be true
test.states.prompt: Which expected fields or values should be checked?

test.states_match.label: Combine expected conditions on one collected item
test.states_match.prompt: How must the State entries apply to the same collected item?

all.label: All conditions
all.description: Evaluate each State entry as authored on the same collected item.

test.require.label: How many collected items must exist and match?
test.require.description: Test-level existence and matching scope. Use the exact versioned requirement token; do not silently reinterpret unknown, error, incomplete, or empty collection outcomes.

state.field.require.label: How many values of this field must exist and match?
state.field.require.description: Applies inside a collected item to the State field (or record member) being checked, not to the collection of Tests.

state.field.equals.label: Must equal
state.field.equals.description: Exact comparison as defined by the authored field's datatype.

state.field.matches_regex.label: Must match pattern
state.field.matches_regex.description: Regular-expression comparison, not a literal-text comparison; a Guided literal-text field may escape the pattern for the author.

object.shared_reference.label: Use an existing data source
object.shared_reference.description: Referenced shared Object must resolve in this Assessment's authoring context.

expression.for_each.label: Repeat for each collected item
expression.for_each.description: Correlation and source scoping must be preserved; the authoring UI must not turn per-parent requirements into a global union.

independent.textfilecontent54.label: Read and match text from a file
independent.textfilecontent54.description: Text collection and pattern/instance selection; do not assume complete-file or rendered-login-banner equivalence.

name.label: Value name
name.prompt: Which named value (or supported default value)?

type.label: Registry storage type
type.prompt: Which kind of Registry data must this entry contain?
type.description: The Registry value TYPE, such as dword, string or multi_string. This is distinct from the comparison datatype of the data stored in value.

value.label: Stored Registry value
value.description: Comparison datatype must be selected explicitly when ambiguous, and must be compatible with the asserted Registry type. The mapping's semantic validator governs cross-type compatibility.

conformance_rules: Never synthesize native enumeration values from displayed labels.
Resolve *_source pointers only within the same pinned capability mapping.
If a referenced enum is missing or mismatched, disable the affected control rather than supplying a guessed list.
Display text is advisory; the normative schema and semantic contract win any disagreement.
